 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Repeat the input tile, alternating its orientation by tile row/column.
    def at(i, j):
        tr, r = divmod(i, n)
        tc, c = divmod(j, n)
        if tr % 2:
            r = n - 1 - r
        if tc % 2:
            c = n - 1 - c
        return grid[r][c]
    return [[at(i, j) for j in range(n*n)] for i in range(n*n)]
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
